stock.description: Hing Ming Holdings Limited specializes in the rental of industrial equipment, primarily offering temporary suspended working platforms. Their equipment roster also includes heavier machinery like tower cranes and power generators. Beyond rentals, the company trades in various new and spare parts, such as permanent suspended working platforms, motors, and wire ropes. They further enhance their service portfolio by providing expert project management and construction consulting. The company serves a diverse clientele, including building contractors, commercial property owners, and trading firms, with operations extending across Hong Kong, Thailand, Macau, Singapore, and international markets. Established in 1997 and headquartered in Kowloon City, Hong Kong, Hing Ming Holdings functions as a subsidiary of Hing Gut Limited.
